create.name: Swami Atmananda Udasin
create.bio:
Swami Atmananda Udasin is a Belgian-born Hindu monk who heads Ajatananda Ashram, a small interreligious monastic community on the Ganges at Tapovan, just upstream of Rishikesh. Before taking up the monastic life he read theology, comparative religion and Indian thought at universities in Louvain, Paris and Jerusalem and lectured briefly at university, then spent about ten years in solitary retreat, first near Jerusalem and later in northern India. His teacher, Sri Chandra Swami Udasin, initiated him into sannyasa in 2001, and the ashram he went on to found takes its name from Swami Ajatananda, a disciple of Swami Abhishiktananda. He also directs the Abhishiktananda Centre for Interreligious Dialogue in Delhi.

Since 2012 he has taught the Direct Path of Advaita Vedanta, drawing on Ramana Maharshi, Nisargadatta Maharaj and Sri Atmananda Krishna Menon as well as his own master. A satsang with him opens in silence, moves to a commentary on a classic non-dual text, and ends with open questions. In the spring and autumn seasons he holds afternoon satsangs and short non-residential retreats at the ashram, spends each January in Tiruvannamalai, and offers online satsangs and retreats in Europe. His talks are given in English or French, with interpretation, and teachings are offered on a donation basis.

courses.title: Open Satsangs at Ajatananda Ashram, Rishikesh
courses.description: Afternoon satsangs held at the ashram in Tapovan during its spring and autumn seasons, open to anyone without booking. Each begins in silence, continues with a talk on an Advaita text and closes with questions to Swami Atmananda.

courses.title: International Retreat in Assisi: Awakening and Non-Duality
courses.description: A residential retreat in the Italian town of Assisi with morning walks in awareness, group meditation, teaching sessions and time for questions, held largely in silence. Teaching is in English and French with interpretation; rooms and meals are booked and paid separately.

courses.title: Satsang Retreats at Ajatananda Ashram
courses.description: Short non-residential retreats at the ashram, held most seasons, combining an early walk by the river, silent sittings, morning and afternoon satsangs and evening chanting. They are a chance to go further into self-enquiry over several days.

Ajatananda Ashram is a centre, not a Spiritpedia listing; teaches_at left empty.

Some online satsangs are in French with English interpretation; others in English. He teaches in English at least in part.
The two most-viewed videos on his channel are talks by other teachers (Sri Swami Ramanacharana Tirtha, Nochur Venkataraman) and were left out.
The Assisi retreat is in Italy (a tour stop, not his base); kept as a dated offering after 7 Nov 2026.
